title: Send Email, SMS and Notifications From Your Module | Orchard Core
description:
A module that needs to reach its users has three things to do: send an email, send an SMS, and leave a notice in the notification center of a user.

Orchard Core provides a service for each one that you inject in your module: IEmailService, ISmsService and INotificationService. The email and SMS providers are selected in the site settings, so your code does not depend on SMTP, Twilio or any other provider.

In this video:
• Three services: one for email, one for SMS, one for notifications, and the features your module declares
• Send an email with IEmailService and MailMessage, and check the Result
• Send an SMS with ISmsService and SmsMessage, and the Log provider for development
• Notify a user with INotificationService and NotificationMessage, and how INotifier differs
• Register a notification type, and keep notifications in sync with INotificationManager
• Extension points: email and SMS providers, notification methods and email events
